coverage.heading: 1. DEFENSA INFRAESTRUCTURAS DE LA PROVINCIA DE BURGOS.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Infrastructure: named A12/A73/A11/AP1 road investment, Madrid-Burgos railway reopening/electrification and Burgos-Vitoria high-speed rail. Budget backlogs and rival-party culpability are source claims, not independently established facts or quiz consequences.

coverage.heading: 2. COHESIÓN Y EQUILIBRIO TERRITORIAL.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Territorial financing: increase the weight of population dispersion/territory in compensation and public-service funds; at least50%electricity-tax revenue kept where generated. Source legal labels/fund figures are not a checked account of current law; no precise weighting replacement specified.

coverage.heading: 3. SERVICIOS PÚBLICOS DE CALIDAD.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Public services: rural and urban quality standards, assistance funding based on real service cost rather than beneficiary count. No exact entitlement, service frequency or cost formula.

coverage.heading: 4. DIPUTACIONES PROVINCIALES.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Provincial deputations: preserve and strengthen, change election weighting toward towns/entities below20,000inhabitants; finance by dispersion and actually served population; upper governments assume inappropriate local competences. No election-weight numeric rule.

coverage.heading: 5. TRANSICIÓN ENERGÉTICA LIGADA A LAS ENERGÍAS RENOVABLES.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Renewables: support transition with territorial participation and associated local manufacturing, maintenance, recycling and training infrastructure. Conditional local benefit demand is not rejection of renewable power.

coverage.heading: 6. HIDRÓGENO VERDE.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Green hydrogen: include Burgos in the national network and support local production. Provincial generation/rank and political-exclusion allegations are unverified source background.

coverage.heading: 7. EDUCACIÓN.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Education: State pact, equal compulsory content across Spain, university access test, vocational education with lower rural student thresholds/mixed flexible provision. Source does not specify a test format or a numerical rural threshold.

coverage.heading: 8. REDUCCIÓN DE LA BUROCRACIA ENTRE ADMINISTRACIONES Y CON LOS CIUDADANOS.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Administration: simplify/rationalise legislation and differentiate municipality reporting duties to free capacity for residents. No specific administrative-rule repeal is identified.

coverage.heading: 9. REPOBLACIÓN y RETO DEMOGRÁFICO.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Repopulation: longer maternity/paternity leave, direct aid and free early childhood education with greater rural preference; demographic ministry/rural directorate and adequate funds. Leave duration and aid amount unspecified.

coverage.heading: 10. AGENCIA DE DESARROLLO DEL MUNDO RURAL.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Rural agency: independent development body modelled on Scottish Highlands,600million-eurobudget; projects for services, education, enterprise pilots, coworking and rural development staff. No annual/one-off budget period.

100/30/30: rural internet at least100megas, basic health/education services less than30minutes and high-capacity road or rail less than30minutes. Source does not define the internet unit or journey mode; preserve ambiguity.

coverage.heading: 12. VENTAJAS FISCALES PARA EL MEDIO RURAL.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Rural tax advantages:20%personal-income-tax deduction for habitual residence in depopulated zones with income below50,000euros; transfer-tax deductions for first-residence transactions below250,000euros in depopulated municipalities. Not a20%blanket rate cut; definition/base and deduction cap unspecified.

coverage.heading: 13. SEGURIDAD CIUDADANA.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Public security: more technical/personnel resources for NationalPolice/CivilGuard, salary parity with regional police. Crime/impunity growth is a party allegation, not a verified premise for a leading question.

coverage.heading: 14. VIVIENDA.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Housing: broaden national housing-plan thresholds, increase municipality cofunding and transfers for rural public housing stocks. No general rent-price cap or forced vacancy policy specified.

coverage.heading: 15. REINDUSTRIALIZACIÓN RURAL.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Rural industry: reindustrialise medium provinces, with Burgos investments along specified territorial/transport axes. Not a fixed nationwide industrial subsidy or guaranteed growth outcome.

coverage.heading: 16. BURGOS PROVINCIA EUROPEA DE LA LOGÍSTICA.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Logistics: central corridor priority, reopen/electrify direct Madrid-Burgos railway, Atlantic-corridor Burgos node and Villafria freight-terminal extension. Do not treat regional references as a general nationwide road-versus-rail trade-off.

coverage.heading: 17. AGRICULTURA y AGUA.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Agriculture/water: strategic farm sector, protect against foreign products not meeting domestic standards; modernise irrigation/cultivation; finish Castrovido dam, increase stored water and recover public water management; improve provincial reservoirs and State support for supply/sanitation. Not a proposal to ban all agricultural imports.

coverage.heading: 18. SANIDAD.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Health: Burgos medical-school advocacy; rural doctors10%remuneration supplement and more competitive-exam points. Applies to rural practising doctors, not all healthcare salaries; bonus duration undefined.

coverage.heading: 19. AUTONOMOS Y PYMES.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Self-employed/SMEs: lower fiscal/bureaucratic burden, simple digital procedures, turnover-related self-employed taxation and100%bonuses in first4years. The bonus base, beneficiaries and liabilities are unspecified, so no exact exemption mapping.

coverage.heading: 20. CULTURA.
coverage.authoredAnalysis: Culture: promote Burgos/Valpuesta as origin/reference for castellano. Historical-origin claims are programme rhetoric, not independently verified curriculum facts. End of twenty national sections; municipal2023andregional2022links are separately labelled and excluded from national policy evidence.
